allow: PowerShell($pts = Import-Csv $env:TEMP\\navmap_pts.csv | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{x=[int]$_.x;y=[int]$_.y;r=[int]$_.r;g=[int]$_.g;b=[int]$_.b} }; $clusters = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList; foreach\($p in $pts\){ $found=$null; foreach\($c in $clusters\){ if\($c.color -eq "$\($p.r\),$\($p.g\),$\($p.b\)" -and [math]::Abs\($c.cx/$c.n - $p.x\) -lt 15 -and [math]::Abs\($c.cy/$c.n - $p.y\) -lt 15\){ $found=$c; break } }; if\($found\){ $found.cx+=$p.x; $found.cy+=$p.y; $found.n++ } else { [void]$clusters.Add\([pscustomobject]@{color="$\($p.r\),$\($p.g\),$\($p.b\)";cx=$p.x;cy=$p.y;n=1}\) } }; foreach\($c in $clusters\){ $px=$c.cx/$c.n; $py=$c.cy/$c.n; $wx=$px/18.015-30.38; $wz=\(804-$py\)/18.015-26.83; "{0,-12} n={1,4} px=\({2,6:F1},{3,6:F1}\) world=\({4,6:F1}, {5,6:F1}\)" -f $c.color,$c.n,$px,$py,$wx,$wz })
